Declaration dependencies from https://github.com/ntrtwl/NitroSDK, commit 9eec6c92c9d7bba9350732b11296ed16aab3a8bc. Only freshly compiled C function bodies with complete local byte equality are counted; assembly bodies are excluded. Headers and the generated fx_const.h are pinned in verification/sdk-header-manifest.json. Source provenance, build flags and original function addresses are recorded in verification/sdk-source-proofs.json. Whole-ROM linking and global ABI remain unverified.
The header inline CLZ assembly definition is replaced by an external declaration. This provides no implementation; functions that require the inline assembly must be excluded unless fresh pure C compilation still reproduces their complete original bytes.
